title: SourceTrace evidence item
description: One piece of content extracted from a source image (PNG/JPG). Findings cite evidence by evidence_id.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for this piece of evidence.

source_id.description: Identifier for the source image, e.g. "slide-01" for slide-01.png.

page.description: Position of the source image in the input set, starting at 1 (one image is one page).

type.description: Kind of content the evidence was taken from.

content.description: The original content, quoted as extracted.

location.description: Where on the page to find it, in words a person can act on. Precise coordinates are not required in v0.1.

certainty.description: Confidence that the content was extracted correctly.
